title: Qualify the candidate on Linux CUDA devices
requires: Registered physical Linux NVIDIA CUDA devices and current shared Slang toolchain
scope: Candidate realtime-single-step-v1-cfb104b failed this required physical row as recorded in docs/roadmap/evidence/F8-24-CANDIDATE-V5-LINUX-CUDA-FAILURE.json and is rejected for final qualification. Await the replacement candidate frozen and routed by F8-63; never union candidate-v5 passing observations with replacement evidence. FINAL RELEASE GATE after rerouting: execute every registered Linux CUDA tuple without changing physics, budgets or advertised capabilities. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md and docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Run every applicable kernel/variant, domain, coupling, lifecycle and negative case in the frozen matrix; record unsupported and missing cases explicitly. All required rows must execute and pass.
Prove one dt=1/60 advance and one spatial publication per tick; verify high-rate interpolation, low-rate slow-motion, no catch-up and fixed dispatch/iteration/synchronization budgets.

Report the fixed profile's independent quality assertions and per-tier CPU/GPU/frame p50/p95/p99 budgets, plus cold-start and sustained runs. Never lower counts/tolerances or substitute another device.

Attach reviewable artifacts identifying exact candidate, binary/deployment, device/OS/GPU/driver/toolchain and manifest hashes; preserve failures and create separate fix/requalification leaves instead of declaring partial success.

Use normal public simulation creation with the sole schedule and no execution-profile opt-in; verify all baseline supported domains/interactions and installed Gallery behavior where applicable. Missing production integration is a failure, not a newly unsupported capability.

history.reason: Candidate v5 fails the required physical Linux CUDA suite: 127/130 pass; device-profile multi-wall stability, dump-truck 100-degree reach, and Gallery headless layer discovery fail reproducibly. Preserve evidence on work/F8-24/ThomasLaptop commit ad7afc7; add bounded repair/refreeze leaves before requalification.
